CWE-295.name: Improper Certificate Validation
CWE-295.rationale: Network reachable, but the attacker must be positioned on the path (high complexity). Traffic can be read and altered, availability is unaffected.

CWE-502.name: Deserialization of Untrusted Data
CWE-502.rationale: pickle and similar loaders execute code from the payload. Full compromise without authentication.

CWE-78.name: OS Command Injection
CWE-78.rationale: Arbitrary commands run as the service account.

CWE-94.name: Code Injection
CWE-94.rationale: eval and exec on caller controlled input is remote code execution.

CWE-89.name: SQL Injection
CWE-89.rationale: Read, modify or destroy the whole database.

CWE-489.name: Active Debug Code
CWE-489.rationale: The Werkzeug debugger console exposed by Flask debug mode executes arbitrary Python.

CWE-22.name: Path Traversal
CWE-22.rationale: Read any file the service account can read.

CWE-611.name: XML External Entity Reference
CWE-611.rationale: Local file read and server side requests through entity expansion.

CWE-918.name: Server Side Request Forgery
CWE-918.rationale: Reach internal services and metadata endpoints from the server.

CWE-798.name: Hard-coded Credentials
CWE-798.rationale: Anyone with the source has the credential.

CWE-400.name: Uncontrolled Resource Consumption
CWE-400.rationale: Remote denial of service without authentication.

CWE-1333.name: Inefficient Regular Expression Complexity
CWE-1333.rationale: Catastrophic backtracking is a remote denial of service.

CWE-732.name: Incorrect Permission Assignment
CWE-732.rationale: A local user can read or replace files the service trusts.

CWE-352.name: Cross-Site Request Forgery
CWE-352.rationale: A logged in user is tricked into a state changing request.

CWE-79.name: Cross-site Scripting
CWE-79.rationale: Script runs in the victim's browser, scope changes to the user agent.

CWE-327.name: Broken or Risky Cryptographic Algorithm
CWE-327.rationale: Protected data recoverable by an attacker with captured ciphertext and effort.

CWE-330.name: Insufficiently Random Values
CWE-330.rationale: Predictable tokens or keys can be guessed.

CWE-319.name: Cleartext Transmission of Sensitive Information
CWE-319.rationale: An on-path attacker reads the data.

CWE-377.name: Insecure Temporary File
CWE-377.rationale: A local user can pre-create or swap the file.

CWE-200.name: Exposure of Sensitive Information
CWE-200.rationale: Limited information leaks to an unauthenticated caller.

CWE-328.name: Use of Weak Hash
CWE-328.rationale: MD5 or SHA1 for integrity or passwords. Exploitation needs a collision or a rainbow table.

CWE-614.name: Sensitive Cookie Without Secure Attribute
CWE-614.rationale: Cookie leaks over an HTTP request the victim is induced to make.

CWE-1004.name: Sensitive Cookie Without HttpOnly Flag
CWE-1004.rationale: Cookie readable by script only if another injection exists.
